title: Business-First AI
text: Every initiative anchored in cost reduction, revenue growth, or efficiency. We never build AI for its own sake — every line of code connects to a business result.

title: Faster Time to Production
text: Idea to production in under 12 weeks. No long consulting engagements. The FDE model eliminates the handoff gap that kills most enterprise AI initiatives.

title: Embedded Engineering Teams
text: FDE engineers work inside your organisation — in your codebase, your sprints, your systems. They build AI that fits your reality, not a generic template.

title: Enterprise-Grade Security
text: Data isolation, RBAC, audit logging, and responsible AI governance built in from day one — not bolted on after the fact. We design all AI with compliance at the core.

title: Outcome-Driven Delivery
text: We define measurable success criteria before we start and report against them throughout. Results are our responsibility — not just yours.

title: Deep Domain Expertise
text: Pattern recognition from real deployments across 10+ industries. Banking, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Retail, Insurance — we understand your world before we build in it.
